Query: A construction business is staffing its project portfolio. Assign every project to exactly one manager and each manager to at most one project, minimizing the sum of assignment costs. Only listed route edges may be used. Managers on leave cannot be assigned, and their skill must meet each project's requirement; skills rank Junior < Intermediate < Senior < Expert. This assignment has no team quotas, activation fees, pairwise costs, or other coupling constraints. Use tenant NORTH as of 2026-09-20. Tables are split across CSVs, but all events for a given (tenant, table, record_id) are stored in one file. Discard future events, then select the greatest integer revision for each record. Identical retransmissions count once; a selected DELETE removes that record. References are tenant-scoped; identity maps reference IDs to entities. Different surviving record_ids represent separate records. Sum each edge's signed charge components after converting each amount with fx: amount * usd_cents_numerator / denominator. Report the minimum total in USD cents, without dividing by 100.

A supermarket is choosing a replenishment order. The supplied CSVs are exports from a shared event store. Plan for tenant NORTH as of 2026-09-20. The table column identifies each logical table; physical folders and row order have no business meaning. For each (tenant, table, record_id), first discard events whose effective_date is after the planning date, then use the remaining event with the greatest integer revision. Identical retransmissions of the same revision represent one record. A selected DELETE removes that record; do not fall back to an earlier UPSERT. IDs and references are scoped to the tenant. The identity table resolves references to entity IDs and kinds. Distinct surviving record_ids are separate records even if they refer to the same entity. Sum the signed monetary component amounts for each edge or item after converting each component using its currency's fx row: USD cents = amount * usd_cents_numerator / denominator. The result, all fixed fees and all adjustments are in USD cents. Report the optimal objective in USD cents without dividing by 100. All quantities and assignments must be integral. Choose nonnegative integer order quantities to maximize total net benefit. An item may be ordered only when authorized=1. Each item is either not ordered or ordered between its minimum_lot and maximum_order inclusive. The per-unit benefit is the sum of its benefit components; each item_fee is a cost deducted once per item type with positive quantity, not once per unit. Each resource has a separate shared capacity: sum its surviving signed capacity_ledger entries. For the resource constraints, convert liters to ml by 1000, hours to minutes by 60, and kwh to wh by 1000; ml, minute and wh are base units. Usage entries are per ordered unit and all usage entries for a resource are additive. For each category, the total quantity must be between minimum_quantity and maximum_quantity inclusive, and its activation fee is a cost deducted once when any item in it is ordered. Incompatible pairs cannot both have positive quantities. A requires row allows a positive quantity of item_ref only if prerequisite_ref also has positive quantity; there is no quantity ratio. Each bundle row adds bonus_cents once if both listed items have positive quantities. The per-unit benefits are finalized economic coefficients; market observations are not contractual purchase limits.
